summary: Preserve omitted nonnullable timeline fields through the signed owner relay so remote conversation frames conform to the published client schema

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: Published schema, operations and contract digest are unchanged.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: Regenerated Rust models omit absent nonnullable optional timeline body fields rather than injecting null. Explicitly nullable reply_to and attribution fields retain their existing serialization. Supplied values and unknown body variants remain readable; Swift and TypeScript generated files are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
